about: Bakeries & patisseries shown on the site are artisan only (user request 20 Oct 2026: 'the more fancy, better, handmade/artisan bakeries, like Bakker Klaas, Norman Bakery and such'). scripts/import_osm.py drops every OSM shop=bakery / shop=pastry EXCEPT: (1) elements listed in 'keep' (artisan confirmed by a source; filled by hand or by scripts/merge_bakeries.py), (2) elements listed in 'branchOf' (another shop of a curated bakery: not shown separately, counted as that curated place). Curated bakeries in data/cities/<city>.json are never dropped. A confirmed vegan/veggie or breakfast level alone does NOT keep a bakery: it must also be in 'keep' (see data/osm/bakeries-pending.json for those waiting for an artisan check). Remove an entry to drop a place again.

node/10295133531.name: Catberry
node/10295133531.description: Fully plant-based patisserie and coffee bar baking its cakes, brownies, cupcakes and frangipane in-house, also serving breakfast, lunch and high tea.
node/10295133531.openingHoursNote: Opening days differ between its own website, FAQ and OSM — check catberry.be before visiting.

node/11004345644.name: Patisserie Suffys
node/11004345644.description: Family bakery-patisserie of Kristof Suffys making bread, viennoiserie, patisserie and chocolates daily in its own workshops, with a second shop in Sint-Martens-Latem.

node/1295215428.name: De Gentsche Koekedoos
node/1295215428.description: Small craft bakery of Patrick Dutilleul and Claudine Leupe, singled out by De Tijd's Sabato as makers of real freshly baked Gentse mastellen, sold on Fridays and Saturdays.
node/1295215428.openingHoursNote: Hours differ between sources (OSM vs bakkerindebuurt.be) — check before visiting.

node/13904090843.name: CoPain
node/13904090843.description: Cooperative bakery founded in 2016 under baker Adriaan Druwé, baking sourdough and long-fermented wheat, spelt and rye breads with flour from Molens Descamps, sold from its shop in the Lousbergmarkt covered market.

node/3457029648.name: Bakkerij Bernard
node/3457029648.description: Gentbrugge bakery-cum-brocante shop where Bernard Van Steenberge bakes sourdough from a starter over 90 years old in a wood-fired oven, plus speculaas and award-winning Gentse mastellen.

node/9264478841.name: Tartelette (Lies & Maurits)
node/9264478841.description: Tartelette bar run by pastry chefs Lies Dhont and Maurits van Lookeren (ex-De Baere and Del Rey) serving seasonal sweet and savoury tartlets finished to order, to eat in or pre-order for takeaway.

node/12345668083.name: Morgen
node/12345668083.note: same shop, OSM node about 170 m off the curated geocode
